keys.rooms.panel: Fly with others: join the open room; in a room, agree to a vote or open the room panel (not during a sound lesson)
keys.rooms.who: Fly with others: who is around (not during a sound lesson)
rooms.title: Fly with others
rooms.nick.label: Your name in rooms
rooms.nick.help: 2 to 20 letters or digits; spaces and - _ . ' are allowed. Others in the room see it while you fly there.
rooms.nick.bad: This name cannot be used. Use 2 to 20 letters or digits.
rooms.create.title: Create a room on this scan
rooms.create.name: Room name
rooms.create.listed: Show it in the list of open rooms
rooms.link.label: Link to this room
rooms.members.title: Pilots here: {n} of {cap}
rooms.list.title: Open rooms
rooms.list.caption: Open rooms, refreshed every 10 seconds
rooms.list.name: Room
rooms.list.failed: The list of rooms did not load.
rooms.say.welcome: You are in the room {name}. {n} pilots. Press {who} to hear who is around.
rooms.say.welcomeLesson: You are in the room {name}. {n} pilots. During the lesson the digits are your answers; after it, press {who} to hear who is around.
rooms.say.lost: Connection to the room lost. Trying again.
rooms.say.noRoom: You are not in a room. Press {panel} to fly with others.
rooms.open.name: Open room
rooms.vote.title: Next scan
rooms.vote.help: The room moves when more than half of the pilots here agree. Everyone lands at the start.
rooms.vote.open: {nick} proposes the scan {scan}. Yes {yes} of {need} needed. Press {key} to agree.
rooms.vote.counted: You agreed to {scan}. Yes {yes} of {need} needed.
rooms.vote.passed: Agreed: everyone flies {scan} now. Loading it.
rooms.vote.failed: Not enough yes votes for {scan} ({yes} of {need}). The room stays here.
rooms.vote.wait: You proposed many scans in a short time. Propose {scan} again in a few minutes.
rooms.race.prep: {nick} starts a race, {laps} laps. Getting the course ready.
rooms.race.resultsMe: Race over. First: {nick}, {time} seconds. You are place {place}.
rooms.race.noTimes: Race over. Nobody finished a lap.
rooms.race.noCourse: The race course did not build on this page. Fly freely; the table comes at the end.
rooms.race.watching: A race is on. You race in the next one.
rooms.race.wait: Many races were proposed just now. Propose again in a few minutes.
rooms.race.standing: Race: place {place} of {n}, best lap {time} seconds.
rooms.race.standingNoLap: Race: place {place} of {n}, no lap yet.
